Read against conventions.md, packet.md (print, fixes, establishment log), units.py / bardo-thodol-001.json
(pilot), bardo-thodol-002 (units.json and review.md) and glossary.json. 53 units checked word by word, original → l → i.

### Changes

- about · minor · "the radiance of his own mind": the text says the lights and sounds are the rang mdangs / rang sgra of "your own reality" (chos nyid, u. 32, 34), not of the mind · now "the radiance of his own reality".
- unit 1 · l · style · "The between first-in" added an "in" the Tibetan does not have (bar do dang po thebs na, no case ending); 002 u. 4 has "the between first" · now "The between first took-hold if".
- unit 1 · i · minor · "the reminder is given in the second bardo; what is in him by nature wakes" dropped the force of gdab bas, "by giving", which makes the reminder the cause of the waking · now "he is reminded in the second bardo, and by that what is in him by nature wakes, and he is freed".
- unit 1 · n · minor · "rab, 'best', is the pilot's word for the highest ability": the pilot has this same phrase, 'pho ba thebs na rab (u. 28); its rab "highest ability" (dbang po rab, u. 4) is a different use · now "rab, 'best', as in the pilot's 'pho ba thebs na rab."
- unit 5 · i · style · "is the sudden dawning of a body made of mind" made the body the thing that dawns; lus su is "as a body" (the note says so) · now "is a dawning, in a flash, as a body made of mind".
- unit 11 · l · minor · "lament uttered": 'don is the present stem ('don / bton / gdon / thon) · now "lament uttering".
- unit 14 · l · style · "worn-out having-come-because" ran 'o brgyal nas 'ongs pas together and lost nas · now "worn-out having-been, then, came-because".
- unit 15 · l · style · "the dead-one by-name" dropped the genitive of tshe 'das kyi ming nas · now "the dead-one's by-name".
- unit 16 · l · style · "with-intention(?) fierce" put the instrumental on the wrong word: the -s is on drag pos · now "intention(?) fierce-by".
- unit 17, 18, 20 · l · style · "the-between" / "the-betweens" with a hyphen, where 002 and the rest of this part write "the between" (hyphens are for fused endings) · now "the between" / "the betweens".
- unit 22 · n · minor · grammatical label: "ma byed cig … ma with the imperative forbids": byed is the present stem (the imperative of byed is gyis); a prohibition is ma + present stem + cig · corrected.
- unit 23 · l · style · "The Three Jewels" in the literal layer; the pilot's l (u. 14) has "Rare-Supreme-Three" for dkon mchog gsum · now "Rare-Supreme-Three".
- unit 23 · n · minor · the log's sense difference at 30.4 (print byas kyang, concessive; other recension byas cing) was not mentioned · added.
- unit 24 · l · style · "terror however arisen having-happened though" put "having" on the wrong verb (shar nas byung yang) · now "terror however having-arisen happened though".
- unit 27 · n · minor · thugs pa'i read as thug pa'i was not called a guess (the log rates it moderate) · now "read, as a guess, as thug pa'i".
- unit 27, 29, 37, 38 · i · minor · rang snang rendered "my / your own projections": nothing in the Tibetan says "project", the note glosses it "self-appearance", and the phrase sounds like remembered English rather than one built from the grammar · now "my / your own appearance".
- unit 28 · n · style · "another doubled-sound word": no doubled word comes before lhang lhang in this part · now "a doubled word".
- unit 30, 31 · i · style · u. 30 supplied "appears" and u. 31 then gave the verb again ("it will dawn"); the Tibetan has one verb, 'char du 'ong ngo, in u. 31 · u. 30 now ends "…and fearsome," and u. 31 begins "will dawn, quivering…".
- unit 37 · l · style · "face-knowing alone by(?)": kyang is "even, also", and "alone" is the sense, not the word · now "face-knowing even by(?)".
- unit 42 · l · minor · "saṃsāra's turning-back(?) having-happened" added "happened" and did not give ru, which the note explains as "camp" · now "saṃsāra's camp having-turned-back(?)".
- unit 44 · n · style · the consort's name was "She Who Rules the Expanse of Space" in the note and "the Lady of the Expanse of Space" in i · note now uses the i's form.
- unit 45 · i · minor · "pure in its own ground": gnas is "place" (the note and l say so), and "ground" is this text's word for gzhi (gzhi'i 'od gsal, u. 7) · now "pure in its own place".
- unit 49 · l, n · minor · "having-[arisen]" supplied a verb in the literal layer; nas without a verb reads naturally as "from" (dga' ba'i 'du shes nas 'ong, "you come out of a notion of delight"), with the same sense as the other recension's 'du shes skyes nas · l now "delight's notion from, come, and:"; the note says so.
- unit 50 · n · minor · "opens the next sentence, which has no verb of its own": that sentence ends in yin no · now "where it has no verb to go with (that sentence ends in yin no, 'it is')".
- unit 51 · n · minor · the log's difference at 35.4 (print yin no, closed; other recension yin gyi, running on) was not mentioned · added.

Severity count: major 0 · minor 13 · style 12 (25 change lines).

### Checked and confirmed (no change)

- Misprint notes in the required form ("The print has X, a misprint for Y, corrected here."): u. 8 མགྲོལ → མ་གྲོལ, u. 46 སྐྲག → བཀྲག, u. 47 སྐྲག་མེད → བཀྲག་མེད, u. 50 མ་བཀྲག་པར → མ་སྐྲག་པར; u. 46 says the print swaps skrag / bkrag three times on these pages.
- Contractions and abbreviations written out and named: པལ (u. 1, also called uncertain), གྶི (20), དངངྶ (26, 32), ཕྲལ (30), ནཾ (42), ནམཁའི and དབྱིངྶ (44), འོངོ (47). Both [?] (པལ u. 1, ངོ u. 26) are called uncertain. The tsheg-only fixes (ལསཀྱི and the line joins) need no note, as in 002.
- Kept-as-printed readings and guessed senses are each called uncertain or a guess: rigs (1), tho yug (5), du skad (11), 'chag pa (12), phyad (13), mdun pa (16), lugs 'byung (17), thugs pa'i (27, now), sgra dag and 'dir btsam (33), kyang gis (37), ru log (42), las ngan gyis (48), gsol ba thob (53).
- Stems and labels: bcom past of 'joms (4); song imperative of 'gro (24); bros past of 'bros (48); bya future of byed, "I shall" (26); de for te after d (7), 'char de for te after r (8); ru the "as" ending after a vowel (42); gi after a verb running on (49); gyis cig for gyis shig (37); ngo sprad past of ngo sprod (20); mchi humble "go" (53). Particle allomorphs in w: 'od kyis, zer gyis, sgras (39); ma 'jigs shig, ma skrag cig, ma dngangs shig (32); thob cig after b (53) — all regular.
- Divisions agree with conventions.md and 002: ཁྱོད་རང, ད་ ནི, ངོ་ ཤེས་པར་ གྱིས་ཤིག, ངོས་ མ་ ཟིན་པས, ལམ་གྱིས "in a flash" (5, as 002 u. 37) beside ལམ་ གྱི "of the path" (4), ཉེ་དུས (fused -s), ཞག་ ཕྱེད་ དང་ བཞིའི, གསལ་གདབ་བས, ཆོས་ཀྱི་དབྱིངས and ནམ་མཁའི་དབྱིངས་ཕྱུག་མ whole (as 002's ཆོས་ཀྱི་སྐུ, ཀུན་ཏུ་བཟང་མོ), དཀོན་མཆོག་གསུམ whole (as the pilot u. 14), མདུན་དུ / ཙམ་དུ / གནས་སུ / སྐུ་རུ attached to the single noun.

### Findings considered and refused

- "the dull white light of the gods" (about, u. 47, 49): kept. bkrag med is "without lustre", and "dull" is the plain English for it; the establishment log uses the same words; l has "lustreless".
- "Great Pointing-Out" in i (u. 9, 15): kept. It renders ngo sprod chen mo by the house "point out", as the title of the instruction; the note to u. 9 explains it.
- ལས་ངན་ as one word (u. 48) where 002 u. 37 has ལས་ བཟང་ངན་: kept. las ngan "bad karma" is a lexical compound; in 002 las is followed by the pair bzang ngan, which is a phrase.
- ཕྱད (u. 13) shown in l as "(turning?)" while the note says the translation passes over it: kept; l gives one possible sense with its (?), i leaves it out, and the note names the doubt.
- u. 2 gsal lam pa "makes a noun of the lam of 002's lam gyis": kept; it is offered as an analysis, the sense "a flash of clarity" is not in doubt, and the other recension's gsal lam me ba supports it.
- u. 43 "Here the first day begins": the print here does not number the day, but the pinned part name says so and the structure of the book (one buddha a day) makes it plain; kept.
- u. 23 ma zhen cig, u. 37 gyis cig (cig where the rule gives zhig / shig): the print's usage, as nyon cig in 002; u. 37 already notes it. Kept.
- u. 3 l "turning-aside there-is-not" without a word for du: the note explains -du med; kept, as 002 renders such forms by sense.
- u. 4 l "by" for the printed kyi: the note says kyi stands for kyis, as the print often writes it; kept, as 002 did for rang gi thub na.
- u. 14 dngangs called the print's spelling of sngangs: kept; the print's form is also a recognised variant, but the note's statement is not wrong.
